evidence: Created "Test Widget Pro" with all fields (name, price, rating, image, affiliate link, tags, description, review, specs, category=Home, featured) via admin; immediately appeared in /products grid and detail page with correct values. Edited Bowflex price 549->579 via admin; /products grid updated to $579 without reload.

issue: Featured "view all" does not filter to featured products; homepage featured section is capped and browsing complete featured set is broken
actual: Marking Test Widget Pro as featured did update it into the (3-slot) homepage featured carousel once another item was unfeatured, but clicking "View all" on the Featured section navigates to /products?featured=true which shows all 10 products (unfiltered) instead of only the featured ones, so visitors cannot browse the complete set of featured products.

evidence: Search "SONY" (uppercase) matched by name -> 1 product; "exceptional sound" matched by description -> 1 product; "WIRELESS" matched by tag -> 1 product; result counts accurate in each case.

issue: New tag assigned to existing product does not become available in the tag-filter list
actual: Edited Philips Hue Starter Kit to add tag "voicecontrol", saved successfully (visible on detail page), but opening Filters on /products the tag-filter checklist (35 items) does not include "voicecontrol" or any newly added tag, so it cannot be selected as a filter.

evidence: Created product with new tags "testtag1, testtag2"; both appeared on detail page product.tags, and searching "testtag1" returned exactly 1 matching product (Test Widget Pro).

On Philips Hue Starter Kit: added tag (voicecontrol), then renamed to "voice-assistant" and removed "automation" in one edit. Detail page tags updated to [lighting, smart-home, ambiance, voice-assistant]; search "voice-assistant" returned 1 matching product.
Created "Test Widget Pro" with category=Home Goods (single-select combobox); it appeared under /category/home count (3->4 products) and detail page category badge showed "Home".
On /products, selecting category filter "Fitness" reduced grid to 3 fitness products (Bowflex, Theragun, Peloton) and result count updated to "3 products found".
Full DOM snapshot of /products grid shows every product card exposes name, category badge, price, star rating, brief description, product image, and a "Buy Now" purchase action link.

issue: Sort works correctly but price-range minimum filter does not exclude products below the selected minimum
actual: Sorting by Price: Low to High and Top Rated both produced correctly ordered results. However, setting the price-range minimum slider to $430 still displayed Sony WH-1000XM5 priced at $399 in the results (8 products found), violating the active minimum-price criterion.

issue: Product additions/edits are not persisted; a full page reload/revisit reverts all admin data to the original seed state
actual: After creating "Test Widget Pro" and editing several products (Philips Hue tags, Sony featured flag, Bowflex price), reloading/revisiting the app (browser_navigate to a fresh URL) reverted the admin product list to the original 9 seeded products with all original values; none of the created/edited data survived.

evidence: Admin form's Category field is a single-select combobox (Tech Gadgets / Home Goods / Fitness); every seeded and created product showed exactly one category badge (Tech/Home/Fitness) in browsing and detail views.

issue: Displayed results can violate the active price-range criterion
actual: With price-range minimum set to $430 (and no other filters), Sony WH-1000XM5 ($399) remained in the 8 displayed results despite being below the active minimum threshold.

issue: Products can be created/published without required content
actual: Created a product "Incomplete Product" supplying only Name and Short Description (no image, no affiliate/retailer link, no full review, no specifications, price left at default 0). The admin form accepted and saved it as a full product entry rather than rejecting the submission or preventing publication.

evidence: Navigating to /product/does-not-exist-12345 showed "Product Not Found" with no unrelated product data; navigating to /category/invalidcategoryxyz showed "Category Not Found" cleanly.

Typing in search, changing category select, changing sort, and changing min-rating/price filters on /products all updated the grid and "N products found" count instantly without any manual reload throughout testing.

Clicking a product's name/image link in home featured, home latest, products grid, and category grid consistently navigated to /product/{same-key} showing that same product's detail page (verified for sony-wh-1000xm5, philips-hue-starter-kit, test-widget-pro).

Buy Now action on product detail page is an <a> tag with target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" and href pointing to an external retailer URL (e.g. https://example.com/sony-xm5), matching the affiliate link set in admin.

issue: Category filter dropdown offered on the category-specific page does not change the active category or displayed products
actual: On /category/tech, the category filter select shows "Tech Gadgets"; selecting "Home Goods" or "Fitness" from that same dropdown leaves the select displaying "Tech Gadgets" and the grid still shows the 3 Tech products unchanged. (The category filter on /products works correctly; only the category-page instance is broken.)

evidence: Sony WH-1000XM5 and Test Widget Pro detail pages both display matching name, category badge, rating, price, brief description, full untruncated review, tags, key specifications, image, and Buy Now retailer action.

Seeded products use relevant tags/categories, e.g. Peloton Bike+ (Fitness) tagged [cardio, cycling, smart-equipment, subscription]; Sony WH-1000XM5 (Tech) tagged [headphones, wireless, noise-cancelling, premium]; identical tag sets shown on both the products filter list and each product's detail page.

Sony WH-1000XM5 shows identical name/price ($399) on homepage latest-tech, /products grid, /category/tech grid, and detail page; detail page's full review (~460 chars) and all 5 key specs render in full without truncation, verified via DOM innerText.
